verdict.rationale: The CLI can create, delete and list databases and branches, which is scriptable by agents, and backups can be created, scheduled and restored on top of the daily defaults. That gives some control over deletion and backup lifecycle. However, nothing documents setting retention periods or purge guarantees, so the privacy-posture side of the story is mostly unevidenced. Missing for 10: configurable backup retention periods, documented deletion/purge guarantees for backups and Insights/query telemetry, any data-retention or privacy policy controls, and independent corroboration.
